page.layout: One text column at right with a narrow note column at left. Notes in the left margin: "Gregor. AbulFed.&c." beside the Avicenna entry, and "in vit.AbuBecr. & fnfius in vit. Othmani an. Hej. 30." beside the Alkoranus entry. Catchword "uxorem" at lower right. Printed page number 362 at top left. No running head.

main_text.p: Avicenna ] ابو علي الحسين بن عبد الله بن سينا الشيخ الرئيس Abu Ali AlHosain Ebn Abdollahi Ebn Sina AlShaikh AlRaiis ( quasi doctorem primarium dicas ; unde vulgò Princeps insignitur) Medicus & Philosophus insignis. patria illi بخارا Bochara, in qua natus est anno Hejrae 370 Nondum decenni major literas humaniores & quicquid scientiarum ad Alcorani intellectum pertinet, calluisse dicitur, & totam ἐγκυκλοπαιδείαν[?] ante annum aetatis 18. absolvisse, quo temporis spatio nec unam noctem integram dormivisse perhibetur, nec interdiu aliis rebus quam lectioni vacasse, cum aliquid illi intellectu difficile occurreret, ad templum, nodi istius solutionem à Deo precibus impetraturus, se conferre solitus. obiit anno H. 428. annos natus 58. Gregor. AbulFed.&c.

Alkoranus ] Impia Mohammedis dictata ne memoriis hominum excidèrent, cavisse AbuBecrum, iis in librum istum translatis, docet Historia Saracenica, in vita AbuBecri, quibus adde ex AbulFeda, in vit.AbuBecr. & fnfius in vit. Othmani an. Hej. 30. أمر بجمع القرآن من افواه الرجال وجريد النخل والجلود وترك ذلك المكتوب عند حفصة بنت عمر زوج النبي ولما تولي عثمان رأى اختلاف الناس في القراءات كتب من ذلك المكتوب الذي كان عند حفصة نسخا وارسلها الى الامصار وابطل ماسواها Iussit colligi Alkoranum ex ore hominum, & palmarum foliis & pellibus, atque ita scriptum relinqui apud Haphsam Omari filiam Mohammedis

page.notes: Arabic passages are copied from the scan; the lines of the Alkoranus entry are read with some uncertainty and should be checked against the image. The Greek word ἐγκυκλοπαιδείαν is partly unclear in the scan. The marginal note reads "fnfius" as printed, which is probably a printing error for "filius". The catchword "uxorem" is at the foot of the right column and is not repeated in the text.
